elements.name: ingestFunctionAppName
elements.label: Ingest Function App Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Ingest Function App — the messaging endpoint Azure Bot calls. Always Consumption plan.

elements.name: ingestConcurrentRequests
elements.label: Ingest Concurrent Requests
elements.toolTip: Maximum concurrent HTTP requests processed per Ingest instance, and the matching Python thread-pool size. Must be between 1 and 32.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 32.

elements.name: ingestMinimumInstanceCount
elements.label: Ingest Minimum Instance Count
elements.toolTip: Minimum instance count for the Ingest Function App. On Consumption plan, this is 0 (scales to zero when idle).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

elements.name: ingestMaximumInstanceCount
elements.label: Ingest Maximum Instance Count
elements.toolTip: Maximum scale-out instance count for the Ingest Function App (functionAppScaleLimit on Consumption plan). Must be between 1 and 1000.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1000.

elements.name: workerFunctionAppName
elements.label: Worker Function App Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Worker Function App — runs the actual GTI query, which can take several minutes.

elements.name: workerHostingPlanType
elements.label: Worker Hosting Plan Type
elements.toolTip: Flex Consumption (default): modern serverless with configurable per-instance memory. Consumption: classic scale-to-zero. Premium is not offered — the worker's cost model depends on paying only while a job is actually running.

elements.name: workerInstanceMemoryMB
elements.label: Worker Instance Memory MB
elements.toolTip: Per-instance memory for the Worker Function App. Only applies on Flex Consumption.

elements.name: workerConcurrentRequests
elements.label: Worker Concurrent Requests
elements.toolTip: Number of queue messages the Worker Function processes concurrently per instance, and the matching Python thread-pool size. Must be between 1 and 32. Each job can run for several minutes, so keep this modest.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 32.

elements.name: workerMinimumInstanceCount
elements.label: Worker Minimum Instance Count
elements.toolTip: Minimum instance count for the Worker Function App. On Flex Consumption, setting a value > 0 keeps that number of always-ready instances pre-warmed for the queue trigger. Ignored on Consumption plan (scales to zero).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

elements.name: workerMaximumInstanceCount
elements.label: Worker Maximum Instance Count
elements.toolTip: Requested maximum scale-out instance count. Azure enforces a hard floor of 40 for this on Flex Consumption specifically — a lower value is silently raised to 40 only on that plan type. On Consumption, any value from 1 is honored exactly.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1000.

elements.name: gtiApiKey
elements.toolTip: Google Threat Intelligence Agentic API key. Stored as a Key Vault secret, never as a plaintext app setting.

elements.name: gtiTimeoutSeconds
elements.label: GTI Timeout Seconds
elements.toolTip: Client-side read timeout (seconds) for a single GTI Agentic API call. Must be between 30 and 1800.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 30 and 1800.

elements.name: maxJobAgeSeconds
elements.label: Max Job Age Seconds
elements.toolTip: A dequeued job older than this (seconds) is treated as stale and dropped with an apology instead of running an expensive GTI query for it. Must be between 60 and 1800.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 60 and 1800.

elements.name: outputFormatInstructions
elements.label: Output Format Instructions
elements.toolTip: Optional formatting instructions applied to every bot response (e.g. "Show severity as bold text instead of emoji"). Leave empty to use the bot's built-in formatting.

elements.name: threadContextMessageCount
elements.label: Thread Context Message Count
elements.toolTip: Number of most-recent channel-thread messages to fetch as context for each query. Requires the bot's identity to be granted the Graph APPLICATION permission ChannelMessage.Read.All with tenant-admin consent — a manual one-time step. No effect outside channels. Must be between 1 and 50.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 50.
